title: Molecular characterization of large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of the lung by multilayered omics analysis.
snippet: Large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (LCNEC) is a rare type of lung cancer with a very poor prognosis, and its underlying molecular features remain elusive. Here, multi-omics analysis of 27 LCNEC cases along with seven small cell lung carcinomas is performed.
